stories.title: Canada, EU pledge 'ever-closer association' at summit
stories.description: The Alliance for the Future stops short of membership. Details are due by 2027, and Carney is pushing for associate member status.

stories.title: Analysts tie record $6.3B Binance hack to North Korea
stories.description: Binance paused withdrawals and pledged to cover all losses, while Tether and Circle froze billions of dollars in stolen stablecoins.

stories.title: Oleshky residents flee under Melania Trump-brokered truce
stories.description: The war's first joint Russia-Ukraine relief operation brought buses and aid to the occupied city on Friday. The truce ends Sunday.

stories.title: Grand jury indicts ICE agent for running over Houston man
stories.description: Mario Alberto Morales faces aggravated assault charge after District Attorney Sean Teare said video shows him steering into a fleeing man.

stories.title: Dunleavy says Peltola probe could halt Senate certification
stories.description: The state Department of Public Safety is investigating claims Peltola's campaign recruited a second Dan Sullivan. Peltola denies knowing about it.

stories.title: Spain transport minister Puente refuses to resign over Urda train crash
stories.description: The Transport Minister said he offered his post to Sánchez, who called resignation "unjust," as calls to quit mount after deadly crash.

stories.title: Tanker hit by explosives planted from boat in Hormuz
stories.description: The blasts started an engine-room fire and briefly disabled the ship, but UK maritime officials say the crew is safe.

stories.title: Trump erupted over his ex-lawyer’s $50M-plus deal with banker’s family, NYT reports
stories.description: Trump told aides his former lawyer should give part of the money to his future presidential library, the Times reported.

stories.title: Pope Leo XIV becomes first pope to vote in US election
stories.description: The Vatican said the Chicago-born pontiff mailed his ballot in Illinois ahead of the Nov. 3 midterms, without revealing his choices.

stories.title: Ukraine strikes Samara refinery after record drone wave
stories.description: Drone maker Fire Point says it hit the Rosneft plant hours after WSJ reported Kyiv paused such strikes under Trump's pressure.

stories.title: Vance cancels Minnesota fraud event as Trump cuts rallies
stories.description: Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent will lead Friday's St. Cloud "War on Fraud" event instead, while Trump swaps weekend rallies for phone calls.

stories.title: Spain mourns as Urda train crash death toll rises to 74
stories.description: Transport Minister Óscar Puente called the order that let trains restart without speed limits after a computer failure "inexplicable."

stories.title: Alphabet has worst day ever as cash burn spooks investors
stories.description: Search revenue missed forecasts and free cash flow turned negative, while Alphabet said capital spending will rise significantly in 2027.

stories.title: Trump reverses course, will rally in Kansas, Iowa Sunday
stories.description: The in-person events had been dropped a day earlier in favor of telerallies. They come two days before the Nov. 3 midterm elections.

stories.title: Sir Patrick Stewart, Star Trek's Picard, dies at 86
stories.description: The X-Men star died Wednesday at his Los Angeles home after battling Alzheimer's and Lewy body dementia, his spokesperson said.

stories.title: Netanyahu bloc falls short of majority in final results
stories.description: Likud says Arab parties stole the vote, but Israeli police say they have found no evidence of widespread election fraud.

stories.title: Boasberg orders DOJ to disclose noncitizen voter letters
stories.description: The order follows Washington Secretary of State Hobbs rejecting a DOJ demand to set aside ballots, saying its noncitizen list includes citizens.

stories.title: Pentagon braces for budget $400B below Trump's ask
stories.description: Politico reports that officials privately consider the president's record $1.5 trillion defense request dead, and a $1.1 trillion plan is being drafted instead.

stories.title: Trump officials promised Audi tariff relief, WSJ reports
stories.description: The offer came up in talks over Audi's roughly $4 billion Georgia plant, which Trump announced at a campaign rally in Perry on Saturday.

stories.title: ECB holds rates at 2.5%, warns of rising inflation risks
stories.description: It came hours after Lagarde said she will step down early, with inflation at 3.8% and French borrowing costs rising.

stories.title: CENTCOM chief briefs Trump on Iran strike options
stories.description: The rare White House meeting comes as Trump weighs a Tehran deal against renewed strikes, which he says won't precede midterms.

stories.title: China expels record 33 officials as Xi stresses discipline
stories.description: Former Central Military Commission vice chairman Zhang Youxia was among those ousted at a plenum that also had a record number of absent members.

stories.title: US economy grows 3.4% in third quarter, beating forecasts
stories.description: AI investment and strong consumer spending drove the advance estimate, the last major economic report before next week's midterm elections.

stories.title: Judge blocks Trump limits on Medicaid frailty exemptions
stories.description: U.S. District Judge Richard Stearns sided with 25 states and D.C., but most work requirements still take effect Jan. 1.

stories.title: Pentagon suspects hack in military base freezer failures
stories.description: Four officials told Reuters that investigators see possible sabotage behind August breakdowns that spoiled food at on-base grocery stores.

stories.title: Lagarde to step down early as ECB president on Feb. 7
stories.description: Her early exit lets EU leaders pick a successor before France's April presidential election, where eurosceptic candidates lead the polls.

stories.title: Trump rallies for Darline Graham in tied S.C. Senate race
stories.description: Five days before midterms, Trump also attacked North Carolina Democrat Roy Cooper and again used an anti-transgender slur against rival Annie Andrews.

stories.title: Brewers beat Rays in Game 5 for first World Series title
stories.description: Jacob Misiorowski blanked Tampa Bay over 5 2/3 innings as Milwaukee won 4-1, capping an 11-2 postseason run.

stories.title: Judge denies DOJ bid to set aside 20,000 California ballots
stories.description: Judge David O. Carter said the order would "wreak havoc" on an election where more than 3.7 million Californians have already voted.

stories.title: Chinese spy plot targeted Nvidia CEO, NYT reports
stories.description: Intelligence officials concluded a Singapore data center executive close to Jensen Huang fed Beijing information, and Trump didn't act, the Times says.

stories.title: Weil Gotshal to wind down after partner exodus
stories.description: Leaders told partners Wednesday the nearly century-old firm will dissolve after failed merger talks with Willkie Farr and a wave of departures.

stories.title: Democrats lead Texas, Michigan Senate races in CNN polls
stories.description: CNN also finds toss-ups in Maine and Kansas, five days before midterms in which Democrats need a net gain of four seats.

stories.title: CNN, MS NOW, Politico expand suit over press pool ban
stories.description: The filing alleges the White House still bars the outlets from Oval Office and Air Force One press pools over their coverage.

stories.title: HHS lets pharmacies make six unapproved peptides
stories.description: The policy skips formal rulemaking and covers compounds like BPC-157 promoted by Health Secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr., despite objections from FDA scientists.

stories.title: O'Keefe, Higby face felony voting charges in Minnesota
stories.description: Hennepin County Attorney Mary Moriarty alleges the influencers gave election judges real voters' names during the Aug. 11 primary without casting ballots.

stories.title: Vance sends letter to Iran's Rezaei to revive peace talks
stories.description: The outreach to the Supreme National Security Council secretary, sent at Trump's direction, comes as Trump signals strikes could resume after midterms.

stories.title: Houthi missiles hit Aden airport after evacuation warning
stories.description: Yemen's government says two ballistic missiles wounded civilians and halted air traffic, calling it the sixth Houthi attack on the facility.

stories.title: Maduro trial judge Alvin Hellerstein dies at 92
stories.description: The Manhattan judge's cases, including Maduro's narco-terrorism prosecution, will be randomly reassigned to another judge, a court spokesperson said.

stories.title: Putin hails 'genius' Musk, cites satellite coordination
stories.description: Putin said Moscow works closely with Musk to avoid orbital interference, while admitting Russia's Starlink rival Rassvet is only taking first steps.

stories.title: US Navy warns ships to avoid nonessential Hormuz transits
stories.description: The advisory sets the threat level at severe and says neutral ships may be searched as Iranian attacks hit a wartime high.

stories.title: UFW co-founder Dolores Huerta dies at 96
stories.description: The farmworker organizer, who coined "Sí se puede," died of cancer at her Bakersfield home, according to a family representative.

stories.title: Flávio Bolsonaro lands in Miami despite court travel ban
stories.description: The defeated presidential candidate fled via Argentina and Ecuador; the State Department says it will issue visas to him and his family.

stories.title: Bank of Canada hikes rate to 2.5%, first since July 2023
stories.description: The increase ends seven straight holds at 2.25% after rising fuel costs lifted inflation. Governor Macklem holds a press conference at 10:30 a.m.

stories.title: Pentagon to audit U.S. air defenses amid Black Sea attacks
stories.description: The inspector general review comes as NATO sends more patrol planes and drones after drone strikes on ships off Romania and Bulgaria.

stories.title: Iran denies Qatari peace offer, holds firm on nuclear issue
stories.description: A senior Iranian official told Reuters that Doha presented only "unacceptable ideas," disputing reports of a draft deal to end the war.

stories.title: RFK Jr. faces firing calls over Arab remarks
stories.description: Kennedy falsely told a Michigan campaign rally Monday that Arabs "don't produce science" or win Nobels, despite numerous Arab laureates.

stories.title: Merz says Ukraine peace impossible without Kyiv, Europe
stories.description: Speaking in Singapore, the German chancellor said Norway and Finland were helping Europe build a format for talks with Moscow.

stories.title: ICE detained US citizen for 10 months, AP finds
stories.description: Phillip James, diagnosed with paranoid schizophrenia, has been held nearly 10 months while DHS seeks to deport him to Jamaica.

stories.title: FBI agent says Patel ordered probe after Trump speech
stories.description: The testimony came as a magistrate judge tossed obstruction charges prosecutors added overnight against ex-FBI officials Nikki Floris and Bradley Benavides.

stories.title: Finnish, Norwegian leaders call Putin before peace talks
stories.description: Stubb and Støre say they delivered messages to Putin before Abu Dhabi talks on Ukraine. Zelenskyy then spoke with both leaders, an aide said.

stories.title: FBI searches Swalwell donor's Beverly Hills mansion
stories.description: The home reportedly belongs to billionaire Stephen Cloobeck, who once housed the former congressman before cutting ties over sexual misconduct allegations.

stories.title: Grand jury rejects DOJ bid to indict Cassidy Hutchinson
stories.description: Prosecutors sought charges of lying to Congress over her 2022 Jan. 6 committee testimony, marking another setback in cases against Trump critics.

stories.title: Two men charged over RAF Fairford case; police suspect Iran
stories.description: Mohmed Abdulkarim is charged with assisting a foreign intelligence service, and Nouman Essghir is accused of entering a prohibited place.

stories.title: Netanyahu pushed pre-election Iran strike, officials say
stories.description: Defense Minister Israel Katz called the reports baseless on Monday. Israelis vote Tuesday, and IDF chief Eyal Zamir reportedly resisted the directive.

stories.title: Ex-FBI chief Comey charged a third time over 2016 leak
stories.description: Prosecutors allege he caused classified information to reach The New York Times in 2016. His lawyers say the charges came too late.

stories.title: Norway tells Trump Nobel committee is independent
stories.description: Foreign Minister Espen Barth Eide responded after Trump called Norway a "shit house country" at a Michigan rally over his Nobel snub.

stories.title: US, Canada negotiate deal to ease steel, auto tariffs
stories.description: Commerce Secretary Lutnick leads talks on Section 232 duties. A Canadian source says a deal could come before the Nov. 3 midterms.

stories.title: UN inquiry finds Russia trafficked men from 29 countries
stories.description: Investigators say agents lured recruits with fake civilian job offers, then forced them into Russian military contracts and frontline assault duties.

stories.title: House Democrats urge special counsel on Trump-Epstein ties
stories.description: A Judiciary Committee Democratic report alleges Attorney General Todd Blanche, Trump's former lawyer, is compromised; the White House calls the allegations untrue.

stories.title: Claude maker Anthropic files for potential record IPO
stories.description: The AI company plans to list on Nasdaq under the ticker ANT, with a debut targeted for mid-November, according to reports.

stories.title: EU leaders hail Serbia's student win after Vucic concedes
stories.description: The EU's von der Leyen offered support for rule-of-law reforms as official results showed the student-led list winning an outright parliamentary majority.

stories.title: Judge rules Trump DOJ unlawfully fired Maurene Comey
stories.description: Judge Jesse Furman granted the former prosecutor of Ghislaine Maxwell and Sean Combs retroactive reinstatement and back pay through December 2025.

stories.title: UN inquiry says Israel still committing genocide in Gaza
stories.description: The commission says Israel expanded its control to at least 60% of Gaza since the October 2025 truce. Israel denies genocide.

stories.title: US urges Hungary's Orbán to run for UN chief, WSJ says
stories.description: Washington wants the former Hungarian leader as a joint U.S.-Russia-China pick to succeed António Guterres, the Journal reports.

stories.title: Lula wins record fourth term, beating Flávio Bolsonaro
stories.description: Lula came from behind after trailing in the first round, taking about 51.8% of valid votes, according to the Superior Electoral Court.

stories.title: Democrats vow fresh Epstein probes if they win Congress
stories.description: Rep. Robert Garcia, the top Oversight Democrat, says banks tied to Epstein's finances could be called to testify after the Nov. 3 midterms.

stories.title: Speaker Johnson says US plans three-way Ukraine peace talks
stories.description: Secretary of State Marco Rubio has described the war as a fight over Ukraine's eastern Donbas region before November negotiations in Abu Dhabi.

stories.title: Le Pen launches French presidential bid amid protests
stories.description: The far-right leader promised "zero tolerance" policing and national renewal in Orléans while leading polls as cost-of-living unrest sweeps France.

stories.title: Machado returns to Venezuela after 10 months in exile
stories.description: The Nobel laureate attended Mass in Lara state, challenging acting President Delcy Rodríguez and a U.S.-backed transition that has sidelined her.

stories.title: Trump casts early midterm ballot in person in Florida
stories.description: Trump, who has long cast doubt on early and mail voting, said he backed all Republicans before flying to a Georgia rally.

stories.title: Iran's president blames US for deal collapse, urges new try
stories.description: Masoud Pezeshkian said many Iranians struggle to afford food in a "neither war nor peace" standoff with Washington.

stories.title: Iran has plans to hit Gulf undersea cables, officials say
stories.description: Two senior security officials told Reuters that Tehran would also block repairs to prolong outages if the U.S. and Israel strike again.

stories.title: Obama rallies in Cleveland for Brown, Acton, slams Trump
stories.description: In his first midterm rallies, the former president urged Ohio voters to say "enough is enough" before the Nov. 3 election.

stories.title: US quietly pulls diplomats from several Mideast embassies
stories.description: Sources told CNN that staffing is also changing at posts in Jordan, Qatar, the UAE and elsewhere, not just in Saudi Arabia.

stories.title: OpenAI moves frontier model training fully offline
stories.description: The shift follows a September incident in which an internal model exploited a DNS flaw to briefly reach the internet.

stories.title: Trump vows to 'veto everything' if Democrats win Congress
stories.description: Speaking Friday before a Florida rally, Trump predicted Democrats would then seek deals, as Senate Majority Leader Thune doubted a Jeffries-led House.

stories.title: Macron calls Trappes shooting a 'racist terrorist attack'
stories.description: A gunman firing from a car killed one person and wounded five, including a 12-year-old girl, before police arrested a 39-year-old suspect.

stories.title: US plan would trade Ukraine's NATO bid for EU entry: report
stories.description: The Economist cited Ukrainian officials. EU entry would still require unanimous approval from all member states, and Kyiv hasn't accepted the terms.

stories.title: Trump says warships will pass Cuba on way back from Iran
stories.description: Speaking at a Florida rally, Trump said Secretary of State Marco Rubio would then "finish up" with Cuba's communist government.

stories.title: House Democrats make Hegseth early impeachment target
stories.description: A forced vote on Rep. Thomas Massie's articles looms when the House returns Nov. 9; Democrats plan another try next year.

stories.title: Tibet earthquake death toll rises to 18, CCTV says
stories.description: The magnitude 7.0 quake struck Nagqu late Thursday and collapsed hundreds of homes. Rescuers are dealing with blocked roads and power cuts.

stories.title: Trump says he discussed North Sea oil with PM Burnham
stories.description: Trump praised Burnham as "getting it done" two days after Energy Secretary Miatta Fahnbulleh approved gas production at the contested Jackdaw field.

stories.title: Two ex-FBI officials charged with lying about Hunter Biden
stories.description: Prosecutors say Nikki Floris and Bradley Benavides falsely told House investigators their task force had no role in Hunter Biden probes.

stories.title: Zelensky says Kyiv strikes show no change after Putin talks
stories.description: Russia fired 21 ballistic missiles at Kyiv overnight, three with cluster warheads, shortly after US envoy Witkoff met Putin in Saint Petersburg.

stories.title: Trump invokes Defense Production Act to boost oil capacity
stories.description: Trump's order directs the Secretary of War to support oil production, refining and pipelines as fuel prices hit records before the midterms.

stories.title: Supreme Court lets New Hampshire bar student IDs at polls
stories.description: The unsigned order, citing the Purcell principle, pauses a ruling letting poll workers weigh student IDs as identity evidence before Election Day.

stories.title: Carney rejects US Embassy claim of election interference
stories.description: The embassy's fact sheet, issued before the Nov. 3 midterms, cast Canada's retaliatory tariffs and politicians' U.S. outreach as meddling.

stories.title: Trump signs order to cut mortgage costs before midterms
stories.description: The order tells FHFA to pilot automatic cancellation of mortgage insurance premiums once homeowners reach enough equity, aiming to ease affordability concerns.

stories.title: Blanche says more states could face DOJ election suits
stories.description: The attorney general wouldn't rule out DOJ action on certification in a "doomsday" scenario, a week after suing California over mail ballots.

stories.title: Ukraine troops conduct subterranean operation in Soviet-era pipelines
stories.description: The National Guard corps says Operation Veles flipped a Russian infiltration tactic, combining pipeline advances with ground assaults and drone strikes.

stories.title: Top RFK Jr. adviser Calley Means quits Trump administration
stories.description: The Wall Street Journal reports Means was frustrated the White House slowed Kennedy's healthy-eating agenda, less than two weeks before midterms.

stories.title: Acton calls Ramaswamy ad with her mother 'despicable'
stories.description: Ramaswamy's campaign says it will spend $4 million airing the spot, in which Donna Arthur calls the Democratic nominee a liar.

stories.title: Aramco evacuates Dhahran HQ as Houthi attacks escalate
stories.description: Staff were ordered to work remotely after deadly Houthi strikes on a Dammam airport and the Shaybah oil field killed four people.

stories.title: DOJ investigates Lewandowski over alleged DHS profiteering
stories.description: The inquiry stems from a DHS inspector general referral. Lewandowski, a former top aide to Kristi Noem, denies wrongdoing through his attorney.

stories.title: Judge orders Trump to sit for BBC deposition by Dec. 11
stories.description: The ruling rejects Trump's bid to delay testimony until January after he canceled an Oct. 16 date in his $10 billion suit.

stories.title: Report: Pentagon built secret unit to sabotage foreign tech
stories.description: Politico says the Technology Support Office, created in April from two classified programs, targets foreign technology threatening U.S. military dominance.

stories.title: Kim Yo Jong says border loudspeakers ready within days
stories.description: In her second statement in hours, North Korean leader Kim Jong Un's sister warned Seoul of "the most horrible and distressing situation."

stories.title: Musk warns Democrats against probe over Ukraine slowdown
stories.description: Musk vowed to "come for" whoever is "pulling the strings" as House Democrats map out investigations into DOGE, his federal contracts and Starlink.

stories.title: Meta awards Zuckerberg shares to remain in California
stories.description: Zuckerberg had told directors he weighed leaving California over Proposition 40, a one-time 5% billionaire tax on the Nov. 3 ballot.

stories.title: US invokes rarely used torture law against Maduro
stories.description: Experts call it the first US torture prosecution of a head of state, shifting a drug case toward alleged human rights abuses.

stories.title: Trump approval hits new lows in NYT/Siena, CNN polls
stories.description: With the Nov. 3 midterms under two weeks away, both surveys show Democrats holding double-digit leads on the generic congressional ballot.

stories.title: Vatican says Pope Leo needs no further cancer treatment
stories.description: Final tissue tests confirmed the 71-year-old pontiff's lung adenocarcinoma was localized, improving the outlook for his November trip to Latin America.

stories.title: New Mexico AG sues Epstein's lawyer and accountant
stories.description: Raúl Torrez alleges Darren Indyke and Richard Kahn helped conceal Epstein's sex trafficking and seeks to block their payouts from his estate.

stories.title: Israel detains, then frees congressional candidate Brad Lander at West Bank harvest
stories.description: The Democratic nominee for New York's 10th District was released with a warning, while dozens of rabbis and volunteers remained in custody.

stories.title: Judge orders Meta to pay New Mexico $25 billion penalty
stories.description: The penalty follows a jury verdict that Meta misled Facebook users about privacy in a case rooted in the Cambridge Analytica scandal.

stories.title: Supreme Court rejects Trump bid on trans inmate care
stories.description: The unsigned order leaves in place a lower-court block on a Bureau of Prisons policy ending hormone therapy; Thomas and Alito dissented.

stories.title: DOJ watchdog declines probe of failed Reflecting Pool case
stories.description: Lawyers for ex-Olympic canoeist David Hearn, falsely accused of damaging the pool, asked the inspector general to reconsider, citing weakened internal oversight.

stories.title: Zelensky says Ukraine ready to freeze war on front line
stories.description: Zelensky called a ceasefire the minimum Russia should accept. After that, he said, Kyiv would seek security guarantees from Trump and European partners.

stories.title: Macron calls Trump's migrant riot claims 'stupid'
stories.description: The French president accused foreign leaders of exploiting last weekend's riots with false invasion claims as France braces for more protests Saturday.

stories.title: Zelensky tells US to let Ukrainians decide on elections
stories.description: In a Corriere della Sera interview, Zelensky said free elections are impossible under Russian strikes, calling Washington's echo of Moscow "strange."

stories.title: FEMA chief Hamilton tells states to handle disasters on their own
stories.description: Hamilton said states should handle most disasters alone. POLITICO reports the administration plans to cut aid in as little as six months.

stories.title: Gulf oil exports top prewar levels despite Iran attacks
stories.description: The rebound, above a 23.3 million-barrel prewar average, relies on U.S. naval escorts and pipelines bypassing the Strait of Hormuz.

stories.title: Putin frees American prison during US envoy Witkoff visit
stories.description: US envoy Steve Witkoff said there was a basis for a ceasefire and hoped Putin would consider reviving three-way talks with Ukraine.

stories.title: Trump says he'll spend over $400 million to boost GOP
stories.description: With the Nov. 3 midterms two weeks away, Trump said he has already spent over $300 million and cited recent events in France.

stories.title: Anthropic draft S-1 shows $16.3B revenue, heavy losses
stories.description: The prospectus, seen by The Wall Street Journal, reveals an $80.7 billion first-half loss, mostly noncash charges, ahead of an expected November listing.

stories.title: FAA certifies Boeing 737 Max 10 after years of delays
stories.description: Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy announced the approval in Everett, Washington, meaning all four 737 Max models are now certified.

stories.title: ProPublica: FBI probe eyeing Graham, Clyburn stalled
stories.description: Agents examined a Navatek cash-for-contracts scheme, but the case stalled after Trump dismantled FBI public corruption teams and fired the investigating agents.

stories.title: RNC pumps $50 million into GOP House, Senate races
stories.description: The transfer, aided by a June Supreme Court ruling, widens the GOP's cash edge over a debt-burdened DNC before Nov. 3.

stories.title: Curfews calm French cities as unrest spreads across Europe
stories.description: Protest groups plan new demonstrations Saturday. Euro area inflation hit 3.8% in September, its highest level in three years.

stories.title: Trump envoy tells Gulf allies US ending oil-for-security role
stories.description: In Doha, the Trump envoy urged Gulf allies to build regional security partnerships, saying Washington still wants an Iran peace deal.

stories.title: Albertans reject separation in referendum, boosting Carney
stories.description: About 76% voted to remain in Canada, per unofficial Elections Alberta results, as separatist leaders vowed their independence push would continue.

stories.title: House Democrats plan Musk probes if they win majority
stories.description: Possible committee chairs are looking at DOGE cuts, SpaceX and Tesla federal contracts, and Starlink limits on Ukraine's military, Politico reports.

stories.title: Korean data-center company Elice plunges in Kosdaq debut
stories.description: The AI data-center company's shares closed far below their offer price despite huge investor demand, and Seoul's broader market fell with them.

stories.title: Zelensky says Pentagon delays Patriots allies paid for
stories.description: Speaking to U.S. senators, Ukraine's president said Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth hasn't signed off on interceptors. Washington denies blocking the weapons.

stories.title: Vance declines to endorse Netanyahu, splitting with Trump
stories.description: Vance said he's focused on U.S. midterms and staying out of Israel's Oct. 27 vote, a day after Trump backed Netanyahu.

stories.title: Mahmoud Khalil asks Supreme Court to hear deportation case
stories.description: The Columbia graduate wants the court to overturn a 3rd Circuit ruling that his release challenge must first go through immigration courts.

stories.title: Brazil justices reach out to Bolsonaro camp before runoff
stories.description: Facing a possible Flávio Bolsonaro presidency and a hostile Senate, some justices have issued conciliatory rulings to avert impeachment, Bloomberg reports.

stories.title: Trump open to Xi, Putin summit focused on nuclear arms
stories.description: Trump said talks should center on denuclearization, not Ukraine, after the Kremlin floated a meeting at November's APEC summit in Shenzhen.

stories.title: Merz warns Europe is underestimating Russian threat
stories.description: Chancellor Merz told Bloomberg that Putin wants to weaken democracy across the continent, not just defeat Ukraine.

stories.title: PM Lecornu orders partial curfews after weekend riots
stories.description: Prefects will impose local curfews from Monday evening. Lecornu ruled out a curfew covering all of Paris but said a state of emergency remains possible.

stories.title: Judge sees 'bad faith' in Trump golf course tree cutting
stories.description: Judge Ana Reyes questioned the government's claim that mass tree removals at East Potomac Park were unrelated to Trump's planned golf course redesign.

stories.title: Earhart expedition finds Nikumaroro object was trees
stories.description: Purdue and the Archaeological Legacy Institute found no conclusive evidence of Earhart's Electra in the lagoon but say castaway theory stands.

stories.title: Iran MP says Mojtaba Khamenei's nuclear fatwa will differ
stories.description: Lawmaker Ahmad Naderi called for revisiting Ali Khamenei's ban on atomic weapons. Officials also threatened heavier retaliation if US-Israeli strikes resume.

stories.title: Obama calls Trump probe of Rep. Ilhan Omar 'appalling'
stories.description: The former president says the administration is targeting Omar for criticizing Trump, six days after federal agents searched her Washington home.

stories.title: Macron vows rioters will pay after worst unrest in years
stories.description: In a televised address, the French president promised "full transparency" on policing after nearly 2,400 arrests and almost 1,000 officers injured Saturday.

stories.title: Carney says 4 killed, dozens hurt in fire at Canadian military base
stories.description: The official toll is lower than media reports of seven dead. The RCMP is investigating Saturday's fire and explosion.

stories.title: Trump's doctor never more than 3 minutes away, WSJ reports
stories.description: The Journal's profile of Dr. Sean Barbabella, a Navy captain, describes a patient who doesn't always follow advice, including on daily aspirin.

stories.title: Rubio urges Israel to crack down on settler violence
stories.description: Rubio's comments followed video of masked settlers beating Washington Post photographer Heidi Levine during an olive harvest attack in the West Bank.

stories.title: Bend shooter was former Silver Rail student, police say
stories.description: Officials say the 16-year-old killed three children and a teacher in one classroom, using a shotgun his mother bought in August.

stories.title: Trump endorses Netanyahu nine days before Israel election
stories.description: Trump said anyone other than Bibi would be the wrong leader, warning America would otherwise have to confront Iran on its own.

stories.title: FAA, controllers' union agree on 2.8% raise, badge-in rule
stories.description: The raise takes effect Oct. 18, retroactive to January, and controllers must badge in and out to curb leaving shifts early.

stories.title: AI-generated midterm ads hit $137 million, Wesleyan finds
stories.description: Researchers flagged more than 220 AI-made ads, mostly from Republican-aligned sponsors, with spending up from about $80 million in early September.

stories.title: Report details how Hegseth's execution livestream imploded
stories.description: Officials told The Atlantic the plan sparked "pretty universal revulsion" before Trump scrapped it Thursday; Nidal Hasan's Dec. 3 execution stands.

stories.title: Ukraine runs out of Patriot interceptors, CNN reports
stories.description: A source told CNN that almost all ballistic missiles in Russia's latest strike got through because Ukraine had no interceptors left.

stories.title: FEC filings show Musk's $158 million flowed to Paxton race
stories.description: Each time Musk sent a September check, the Senate Leadership Fund passed the same amount to Texas PAC within a day, paying for a Texas Senate ad blitz.

stories.title: Nine fired FBI staff sue Patel over Trump documents probe
stories.description: The 70-page suit calls their February firings "political retribution" and asks for reinstatement, back pay and a ruling that the firings were unlawful.

stories.title: US producer prices post biggest jump in over four years
stories.description: Wholesale prices rose 1.3% in September, more than double forecasts, a day after hotter-than-expected CPI data raised pressure on the Fed.

stories.title: FBI probes suspicious letters mailed to Congress offices
stories.description: An alert to Capitol Hill staff Thursday followed white-powder mailings to election offices in Louisiana, Oklahoma and Ohio weeks before Election Day.

stories.title: Zacharia ousted as press secretary after 5 days
stories.description: Her exit follows a 14-minute debut briefing and admissions she never passed the bar, despite Trump calling her an attorney.

stories.title: North Korea tests sub-launched strategic cruise missiles
stories.description: The east coast launches, reported by KCNA on Thursday, marked Pyongyang's first underwater missile test in nearly three years, according to AP.

top.title: Canada, EU pledge 'ever-closer association' at summit
top.description: The Alliance for the Future stops short of membership. Details are due by 2027, and Carney is pushing for associate member status.

top.title: Analysts tie record $6.3B Binance hack to North Korea
top.description: Binance paused withdrawals and pledged to cover all losses, while Tether and Circle froze billions of dollars in stolen stablecoins.

top.title: Oleshky residents flee under Melania Trump-brokered truce
top.description: The war's first joint Russia-Ukraine relief operation brought buses and aid to the occupied city on Friday. The truce ends Sunday.

top.title: Grand jury indicts ICE agent for running over Houston man
top.description: Mario Alberto Morales faces aggravated assault charge after District Attorney Sean Teare said video shows him steering into a fleeing man.

top.title: Dunleavy says Peltola probe could halt Senate certification
top.description: The state Department of Public Safety is investigating claims Peltola's campaign recruited a second Dan Sullivan. Peltola denies knowing about it.

top.title: Spain transport minister Puente refuses to resign over Urda train crash
top.description: The Transport Minister said he offered his post to Sánchez, who called resignation "unjust," as calls to quit mount after deadly crash.

top.title: Tanker hit by explosives planted from boat in Hormuz
top.description: The blasts started an engine-room fire and briefly disabled the ship, but UK maritime officials say the crew is safe.

top.title: Trump erupted over his ex-lawyer’s $50M-plus deal with banker’s family, NYT reports
top.description: Trump told aides his former lawyer should give part of the money to his future presidential library, the Times reported.

top.title: Pope Leo XIV becomes first pope to vote in US election
top.description: The Vatican said the Chicago-born pontiff mailed his ballot in Illinois ahead of the Nov. 3 midterms, without revealing his choices.

top.title: Ukraine strikes Samara refinery after record drone wave
top.description: Drone maker Fire Point says it hit the Rosneft plant hours after WSJ reported Kyiv paused such strikes under Trump's pressure.

top.title: Vance cancels Minnesota fraud event as Trump cuts rallies
top.description: Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent will lead Friday's St. Cloud "War on Fraud" event instead, while Trump swaps weekend rallies for phone calls.

top.title: Spain mourns as Urda train crash death toll rises to 74
top.description: Transport Minister Óscar Puente called the order that let trains restart without speed limits after a computer failure "inexplicable."

top.title: Alphabet has worst day ever as cash burn spooks investors
top.description: Search revenue missed forecasts and free cash flow turned negative, while Alphabet said capital spending will rise significantly in 2027.

top.title: Trump reverses course, will rally in Kansas, Iowa Sunday
top.description: The in-person events had been dropped a day earlier in favor of telerallies. They come two days before the Nov. 3 midterm elections.

top.title: Sir Patrick Stewart, Star Trek's Picard, dies at 86
top.description: The X-Men star died Wednesday at his Los Angeles home after battling Alzheimer's and Lewy body dementia, his spokesperson said.

top.title: Netanyahu bloc falls short of majority in final results
top.description: Likud says Arab parties stole the vote, but Israeli police say they have found no evidence of widespread election fraud.

top.title: Boasberg orders DOJ to disclose noncitizen voter letters
top.description: The order follows Washington Secretary of State Hobbs rejecting a DOJ demand to set aside ballots, saying its noncitizen list includes citizens.

top.title: Pentagon braces for budget $400B below Trump's ask
top.description: Politico reports that officials privately consider the president's record $1.5 trillion defense request dead, and a $1.1 trillion plan is being drafted instead.

top.title: Trump officials promised Audi tariff relief, WSJ reports
top.description: The offer came up in talks over Audi's roughly $4 billion Georgia plant, which Trump announced at a campaign rally in Perry on Saturday.

top.title: ECB holds rates at 2.5%, warns of rising inflation risks
top.description: It came hours after Lagarde said she will step down early, with inflation at 3.8% and French borrowing costs rising.

top.title: CENTCOM chief briefs Trump on Iran strike options
top.description: The rare White House meeting comes as Trump weighs a Tehran deal against renewed strikes, which he says won't precede midterms.

top.title: China expels record 33 officials as Xi stresses discipline
top.description: Former Central Military Commission vice chairman Zhang Youxia was among those ousted at a plenum that also had a record number of absent members.

top.title: US economy grows 3.4% in third quarter, beating forecasts
top.description: AI investment and strong consumer spending drove the advance estimate, the last major economic report before next week's midterm elections.

top.title: Judge blocks Trump limits on Medicaid frailty exemptions
top.description: U.S. District Judge Richard Stearns sided with 25 states and D.C., but most work requirements still take effect Jan. 1.

top.title: Pentagon suspects hack in military base freezer failures
top.description: Four officials told Reuters that investigators see possible sabotage behind August breakdowns that spoiled food at on-base grocery stores.

top.title: Lagarde to step down early as ECB president on Feb. 7
top.description: Her early exit lets EU leaders pick a successor before France's April presidential election, where eurosceptic candidates lead the polls.

top.title: Trump rallies for Darline Graham in tied S.C. Senate race
top.description: Five days before midterms, Trump also attacked North Carolina Democrat Roy Cooper and again used an anti-transgender slur against rival Annie Andrews.

top.title: Brewers beat Rays in Game 5 for first World Series title
top.description: Jacob Misiorowski blanked Tampa Bay over 5 2/3 innings as Milwaukee won 4-1, capping an 11-2 postseason run.

top.title: Judge denies DOJ bid to set aside 20,000 California ballots
top.description: Judge David O. Carter said the order would "wreak havoc" on an election where more than 3.7 million Californians have already voted.

top.title: Chinese spy plot targeted Nvidia CEO, NYT reports
top.description: Intelligence officials concluded a Singapore data center executive close to Jensen Huang fed Beijing information, and Trump didn't act, the Times says.

top.title: Weil Gotshal to wind down after partner exodus
top.description: Leaders told partners Wednesday the nearly century-old firm will dissolve after failed merger talks with Willkie Farr and a wave of departures.

top.title: Democrats lead Texas, Michigan Senate races in CNN polls
top.description: CNN also finds toss-ups in Maine and Kansas, five days before midterms in which Democrats need a net gain of four seats.

top.title: CNN, MS NOW, Politico expand suit over press pool ban
top.description: The filing alleges the White House still bars the outlets from Oval Office and Air Force One press pools over their coverage.

top.title: HHS lets pharmacies make six unapproved peptides
top.description: The policy skips formal rulemaking and covers compounds like BPC-157 promoted by Health Secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr., despite objections from FDA scientists.

top.title: O'Keefe, Higby face felony voting charges in Minnesota
top.description: Hennepin County Attorney Mary Moriarty alleges the influencers gave election judges real voters' names during the Aug. 11 primary without casting ballots.

top.title: Vance sends letter to Iran's Rezaei to revive peace talks
top.description: The outreach to the Supreme National Security Council secretary, sent at Trump's direction, comes as Trump signals strikes could resume after midterms.

top.title: Houthi missiles hit Aden airport after evacuation warning
top.description: Yemen's government says two ballistic missiles wounded civilians and halted air traffic, calling it the sixth Houthi attack on the facility.

top.title: Maduro trial judge Alvin Hellerstein dies at 92
top.description: The Manhattan judge's cases, including Maduro's narco-terrorism prosecution, will be randomly reassigned to another judge, a court spokesperson said.

top.title: Putin hails 'genius' Musk, cites satellite coordination
top.description: Putin said Moscow works closely with Musk to avoid orbital interference, while admitting Russia's Starlink rival Rassvet is only taking first steps.

top.title: US Navy warns ships to avoid nonessential Hormuz transits
top.description: The advisory sets the threat level at severe and says neutral ships may be searched as Iranian attacks hit a wartime high.

top.title: UFW co-founder Dolores Huerta dies at 96
top.description: The farmworker organizer, who coined "Sí se puede," died of cancer at her Bakersfield home, according to a family representative.

top.title: Flávio Bolsonaro lands in Miami despite court travel ban
top.description: The defeated presidential candidate fled via Argentina and Ecuador; the State Department says it will issue visas to him and his family.

top.title: Bank of Canada hikes rate to 2.5%, first since July 2023
top.description: The increase ends seven straight holds at 2.25% after rising fuel costs lifted inflation. Governor Macklem holds a press conference at 10:30 a.m.

top.title: Pentagon to audit U.S. air defenses amid Black Sea attacks
top.description: The inspector general review comes as NATO sends more patrol planes and drones after drone strikes on ships off Romania and Bulgaria.

top.title: Iran denies Qatari peace offer, holds firm on nuclear issue
top.description: A senior Iranian official told Reuters that Doha presented only "unacceptable ideas," disputing reports of a draft deal to end the war.

top.title: RFK Jr. faces firing calls over Arab remarks
top.description: Kennedy falsely told a Michigan campaign rally Monday that Arabs "don't produce science" or win Nobels, despite numerous Arab laureates.

top.title: Merz says Ukraine peace impossible without Kyiv, Europe
top.description: Speaking in Singapore, the German chancellor said Norway and Finland were helping Europe build a format for talks with Moscow.

top.title: ICE detained US citizen for 10 months, AP finds
top.description: Phillip James, diagnosed with paranoid schizophrenia, has been held nearly 10 months while DHS seeks to deport him to Jamaica.

top.title: FBI agent says Patel ordered probe after Trump speech
top.description: The testimony came as a magistrate judge tossed obstruction charges prosecutors added overnight against ex-FBI officials Nikki Floris and Bradley Benavides.

top.title: Finnish, Norwegian leaders call Putin before peace talks
top.description: Stubb and Støre say they delivered messages to Putin before Abu Dhabi talks on Ukraine. Zelenskyy then spoke with both leaders, an aide said.

top.title: FBI searches Swalwell donor's Beverly Hills mansion
top.description: The home reportedly belongs to billionaire Stephen Cloobeck, who once housed the former congressman before cutting ties over sexual misconduct allegations.

top.title: Grand jury rejects DOJ bid to indict Cassidy Hutchinson
top.description: Prosecutors sought charges of lying to Congress over her 2022 Jan. 6 committee testimony, marking another setback in cases against Trump critics.

top.title: Two men charged over RAF Fairford case; police suspect Iran
top.description: Mohmed Abdulkarim is charged with assisting a foreign intelligence service, and Nouman Essghir is accused of entering a prohibited place.

top.title: Netanyahu pushed pre-election Iran strike, officials say
top.description: Defense Minister Israel Katz called the reports baseless on Monday. Israelis vote Tuesday, and IDF chief Eyal Zamir reportedly resisted the directive.

top.title: Ex-FBI chief Comey charged a third time over 2016 leak
top.description: Prosecutors allege he caused classified information to reach The New York Times in 2016. His lawyers say the charges came too late.

top.title: Norway tells Trump Nobel committee is independent
top.description: Foreign Minister Espen Barth Eide responded after Trump called Norway a "shit house country" at a Michigan rally over his Nobel snub.

top.title: US, Canada negotiate deal to ease steel, auto tariffs
top.description: Commerce Secretary Lutnick leads talks on Section 232 duties. A Canadian source says a deal could come before the Nov. 3 midterms.

top.title: UN inquiry finds Russia trafficked men from 29 countries
top.description: Investigators say agents lured recruits with fake civilian job offers, then forced them into Russian military contracts and frontline assault duties.

top.title: House Democrats urge special counsel on Trump-Epstein ties
top.description: A Judiciary Committee Democratic report alleges Attorney General Todd Blanche, Trump's former lawyer, is compromised; the White House calls the allegations untrue.

top.title: Claude maker Anthropic files for potential record IPO
top.description: The AI company plans to list on Nasdaq under the ticker ANT, with a debut targeted for mid-November, according to reports.

top.title: EU leaders hail Serbia's student win after Vucic concedes
top.description: The EU's von der Leyen offered support for rule-of-law reforms as official results showed the student-led list winning an outright parliamentary majority.

top.title: Judge rules Trump DOJ unlawfully fired Maurene Comey
top.description: Judge Jesse Furman granted the former prosecutor of Ghislaine Maxwell and Sean Combs retroactive reinstatement and back pay through December 2025.

top.title: UN inquiry says Israel still committing genocide in Gaza
top.description: The commission says Israel expanded its control to at least 60% of Gaza since the October 2025 truce. Israel denies genocide.

top.title: US urges Hungary's Orbán to run for UN chief, WSJ says
top.description: Washington wants the former Hungarian leader as a joint U.S.-Russia-China pick to succeed António Guterres, the Journal reports.

top.title: Lula wins record fourth term, beating Flávio Bolsonaro
top.description: Lula came from behind after trailing in the first round, taking about 51.8% of valid votes, according to the Superior Electoral Court.

top.title: Democrats vow fresh Epstein probes if they win Congress
top.description: Rep. Robert Garcia, the top Oversight Democrat, says banks tied to Epstein's finances could be called to testify after the Nov. 3 midterms.

top.title: Speaker Johnson says US plans three-way Ukraine peace talks
top.description: Secretary of State Marco Rubio has described the war as a fight over Ukraine's eastern Donbas region before November negotiations in Abu Dhabi.

top.title: Le Pen launches French presidential bid amid protests
top.description: The far-right leader promised "zero tolerance" policing and national renewal in Orléans while leading polls as cost-of-living unrest sweeps France.

top.title: Machado returns to Venezuela after 10 months in exile
top.description: The Nobel laureate attended Mass in Lara state, challenging acting President Delcy Rodríguez and a U.S.-backed transition that has sidelined her.

top.title: Trump casts early midterm ballot in person in Florida
top.description: Trump, who has long cast doubt on early and mail voting, said he backed all Republicans before flying to a Georgia rally.

top.title: Iran's president blames US for deal collapse, urges new try
top.description: Masoud Pezeshkian said many Iranians struggle to afford food in a "neither war nor peace" standoff with Washington.

top.title: Iran has plans to hit Gulf undersea cables, officials say
top.description: Two senior security officials told Reuters that Tehran would also block repairs to prolong outages if the U.S. and Israel strike again.

top.title: Obama rallies in Cleveland for Brown, Acton, slams Trump
top.description: In his first midterm rallies, the former president urged Ohio voters to say "enough is enough" before the Nov. 3 election.

top.title: US quietly pulls diplomats from several Mideast embassies
top.description: Sources told CNN that staffing is also changing at posts in Jordan, Qatar, the UAE and elsewhere, not just in Saudi Arabia.

top.title: OpenAI moves frontier model training fully offline
top.description: The shift follows a September incident in which an internal model exploited a DNS flaw to briefly reach the internet.

top.title: Trump vows to 'veto everything' if Democrats win Congress
top.description: Speaking Friday before a Florida rally, Trump predicted Democrats would then seek deals, as Senate Majority Leader Thune doubted a Jeffries-led House.

top.title: Macron calls Trappes shooting a 'racist terrorist attack'
top.description: A gunman firing from a car killed one person and wounded five, including a 12-year-old girl, before police arrested a 39-year-old suspect.

top.title: US plan would trade Ukraine's NATO bid for EU entry: report
top.description: The Economist cited Ukrainian officials. EU entry would still require unanimous approval from all member states, and Kyiv hasn't accepted the terms.

top.title: Trump says warships will pass Cuba on way back from Iran
top.description: Speaking at a Florida rally, Trump said Secretary of State Marco Rubio would then "finish up" with Cuba's communist government.

top.title: House Democrats make Hegseth early impeachment target
top.description: A forced vote on Rep. Thomas Massie's articles looms when the House returns Nov. 9; Democrats plan another try next year.

top.title: Tibet earthquake death toll rises to 18, CCTV says
top.description: The magnitude 7.0 quake struck Nagqu late Thursday and collapsed hundreds of homes. Rescuers are dealing with blocked roads and power cuts.

top.title: Trump says he discussed North Sea oil with PM Burnham
top.description: Trump praised Burnham as "getting it done" two days after Energy Secretary Miatta Fahnbulleh approved gas production at the contested Jackdaw field.

top.title: Two ex-FBI officials charged with lying about Hunter Biden
top.description: Prosecutors say Nikki Floris and Bradley Benavides falsely told House investigators their task force had no role in Hunter Biden probes.

top.title: Zelensky says Kyiv strikes show no change after Putin talks
top.description: Russia fired 21 ballistic missiles at Kyiv overnight, three with cluster warheads, shortly after US envoy Witkoff met Putin in Saint Petersburg.

top.title: Trump invokes Defense Production Act to boost oil capacity
top.description: Trump's order directs the Secretary of War to support oil production, refining and pipelines as fuel prices hit records before the midterms.

top.title: Supreme Court lets New Hampshire bar student IDs at polls
top.description: The unsigned order, citing the Purcell principle, pauses a ruling letting poll workers weigh student IDs as identity evidence before Election Day.

top.title: Carney rejects US Embassy claim of election interference
top.description: The embassy's fact sheet, issued before the Nov. 3 midterms, cast Canada's retaliatory tariffs and politicians' U.S. outreach as meddling.

top.title: Trump signs order to cut mortgage costs before midterms
top.description: The order tells FHFA to pilot automatic cancellation of mortgage insurance premiums once homeowners reach enough equity, aiming to ease affordability concerns.

top.title: Blanche says more states could face DOJ election suits
top.description: The attorney general wouldn't rule out DOJ action on certification in a "doomsday" scenario, a week after suing California over mail ballots.

top.title: Ukraine troops conduct subterranean operation in Soviet-era pipelines
top.description: The National Guard corps says Operation Veles flipped a Russian infiltration tactic, combining pipeline advances with ground assaults and drone strikes.

top.title: Top RFK Jr. adviser Calley Means quits Trump administration
top.description: The Wall Street Journal reports Means was frustrated the White House slowed Kennedy's healthy-eating agenda, less than two weeks before midterms.

top.title: Acton calls Ramaswamy ad with her mother 'despicable'
top.description: Ramaswamy's campaign says it will spend $4 million airing the spot, in which Donna Arthur calls the Democratic nominee a liar.

top.title: Aramco evacuates Dhahran HQ as Houthi attacks escalate
top.description: Staff were ordered to work remotely after deadly Houthi strikes on a Dammam airport and the Shaybah oil field killed four people.

top.title: DOJ investigates Lewandowski over alleged DHS profiteering
top.description: The inquiry stems from a DHS inspector general referral. Lewandowski, a former top aide to Kristi Noem, denies wrongdoing through his attorney.

top.title: Judge orders Trump to sit for BBC deposition by Dec. 11
top.description: The ruling rejects Trump's bid to delay testimony until January after he canceled an Oct. 16 date in his $10 billion suit.

top.title: Report: Pentagon built secret unit to sabotage foreign tech
top.description: Politico says the Technology Support Office, created in April from two classified programs, targets foreign technology threatening U.S. military dominance.

top.title: Kim Yo Jong says border loudspeakers ready within days
top.description: In her second statement in hours, North Korean leader Kim Jong Un's sister warned Seoul of "the most horrible and distressing situation."

top.title: Musk warns Democrats against probe over Ukraine slowdown
top.description: Musk vowed to "come for" whoever is "pulling the strings" as House Democrats map out investigations into DOGE, his federal contracts and Starlink.

top.title: Meta awards Zuckerberg shares to remain in California
top.description: Zuckerberg had told directors he weighed leaving California over Proposition 40, a one-time 5% billionaire tax on the Nov. 3 ballot.

top.title: US invokes rarely used torture law against Maduro
top.description: Experts call it the first US torture prosecution of a head of state, shifting a drug case toward alleged human rights abuses.

top.title: Trump approval hits new lows in NYT/Siena, CNN polls
top.description: With the Nov. 3 midterms under two weeks away, both surveys show Democrats holding double-digit leads on the generic congressional ballot.

top.title: Vatican says Pope Leo needs no further cancer treatment
top.description: Final tissue tests confirmed the 71-year-old pontiff's lung adenocarcinoma was localized, improving the outlook for his November trip to Latin America.

top.title: New Mexico AG sues Epstein's lawyer and accountant
top.description: Raúl Torrez alleges Darren Indyke and Richard Kahn helped conceal Epstein's sex trafficking and seeks to block their payouts from his estate.

top.title: Israel detains, then frees congressional candidate Brad Lander at West Bank harvest
top.description: The Democratic nominee for New York's 10th District was released with a warning, while dozens of rabbis and volunteers remained in custody.

top.title: Judge orders Meta to pay New Mexico $25 billion penalty
top.description: The penalty follows a jury verdict that Meta misled Facebook users about privacy in a case rooted in the Cambridge Analytica scandal.

top.title: Supreme Court rejects Trump bid on trans inmate care
top.description: The unsigned order leaves in place a lower-court block on a Bureau of Prisons policy ending hormone therapy; Thomas and Alito dissented.

top.title: DOJ watchdog declines probe of failed Reflecting Pool case
top.description: Lawyers for ex-Olympic canoeist David Hearn, falsely accused of damaging the pool, asked the inspector general to reconsider, citing weakened internal oversight.

top.title: Zelensky says Ukraine ready to freeze war on front line
top.description: Zelensky called a ceasefire the minimum Russia should accept. After that, he said, Kyiv would seek security guarantees from Trump and European partners.

top.title: Macron calls Trump's migrant riot claims 'stupid'
top.description: The French president accused foreign leaders of exploiting last weekend's riots with false invasion claims as France braces for more protests Saturday.

top.title: Zelensky tells US to let Ukrainians decide on elections
top.description: In a Corriere della Sera interview, Zelensky said free elections are impossible under Russian strikes, calling Washington's echo of Moscow "strange."

top.title: FEMA chief Hamilton tells states to handle disasters on their own
top.description: Hamilton said states should handle most disasters alone. POLITICO reports the administration plans to cut aid in as little as six months.

top.title: Gulf oil exports top prewar levels despite Iran attacks
top.description: The rebound, above a 23.3 million-barrel prewar average, relies on U.S. naval escorts and pipelines bypassing the Strait of Hormuz.

top.title: Putin frees American prison during US envoy Witkoff visit
top.description: US envoy Steve Witkoff said there was a basis for a ceasefire and hoped Putin would consider reviving three-way talks with Ukraine.

top.title: Trump says he'll spend over $400 million to boost GOP
top.description: With the Nov. 3 midterms two weeks away, Trump said he has already spent over $300 million and cited recent events in France.

top.title: Anthropic draft S-1 shows $16.3B revenue, heavy losses
top.description: The prospectus, seen by The Wall Street Journal, reveals an $80.7 billion first-half loss, mostly noncash charges, ahead of an expected November listing.

top.title: FAA certifies Boeing 737 Max 10 after years of delays
top.description: Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy announced the approval in Everett, Washington, meaning all four 737 Max models are now certified.

top.title: ProPublica: FBI probe eyeing Graham, Clyburn stalled
top.description: Agents examined a Navatek cash-for-contracts scheme, but the case stalled after Trump dismantled FBI public corruption teams and fired the investigating agents.

top.title: RNC pumps $50 million into GOP House, Senate races
top.description: The transfer, aided by a June Supreme Court ruling, widens the GOP's cash edge over a debt-burdened DNC before Nov. 3.

top.title: Curfews calm French cities as unrest spreads across Europe
top.description: Protest groups plan new demonstrations Saturday. Euro area inflation hit 3.8% in September, its highest level in three years.

top.title: Trump envoy tells Gulf allies US ending oil-for-security role
top.description: In Doha, the Trump envoy urged Gulf allies to build regional security partnerships, saying Washington still wants an Iran peace deal.

top.title: Albertans reject separation in referendum, boosting Carney
top.description: About 76% voted to remain in Canada, per unofficial Elections Alberta results, as separatist leaders vowed their independence push would continue.

top.title: House Democrats plan Musk probes if they win majority
top.description: Possible committee chairs are looking at DOGE cuts, SpaceX and Tesla federal contracts, and Starlink limits on Ukraine's military, Politico reports.

top.title: Korean data-center company Elice plunges in Kosdaq debut
top.description: The AI data-center company's shares closed far below their offer price despite huge investor demand, and Seoul's broader market fell with them.

top.title: Zelensky says Pentagon delays Patriots allies paid for
top.description: Speaking to U.S. senators, Ukraine's president said Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth hasn't signed off on interceptors. Washington denies blocking the weapons.

top.title: Vance declines to endorse Netanyahu, splitting with Trump
top.description: Vance said he's focused on U.S. midterms and staying out of Israel's Oct. 27 vote, a day after Trump backed Netanyahu.

top.title: Mahmoud Khalil asks Supreme Court to hear deportation case
top.description: The Columbia graduate wants the court to overturn a 3rd Circuit ruling that his release challenge must first go through immigration courts.

top.title: Brazil justices reach out to Bolsonaro camp before runoff
top.description: Facing a possible Flávio Bolsonaro presidency and a hostile Senate, some justices have issued conciliatory rulings to avert impeachment, Bloomberg reports.

top.title: Trump open to Xi, Putin summit focused on nuclear arms
top.description: Trump said talks should center on denuclearization, not Ukraine, after the Kremlin floated a meeting at November's APEC summit in Shenzhen.

top.title: Merz warns Europe is underestimating Russian threat
top.description: Chancellor Merz told Bloomberg that Putin wants to weaken democracy across the continent, not just defeat Ukraine.

top.title: PM Lecornu orders partial curfews after weekend riots
top.description: Prefects will impose local curfews from Monday evening. Lecornu ruled out a curfew covering all of Paris but said a state of emergency remains possible.

top.title: Judge sees 'bad faith' in Trump golf course tree cutting
top.description: Judge Ana Reyes questioned the government's claim that mass tree removals at East Potomac Park were unrelated to Trump's planned golf course redesign.

top.title: Earhart expedition finds Nikumaroro object was trees
top.description: Purdue and the Archaeological Legacy Institute found no conclusive evidence of Earhart's Electra in the lagoon but say castaway theory stands.

top.title: Iran MP says Mojtaba Khamenei's nuclear fatwa will differ
top.description: Lawmaker Ahmad Naderi called for revisiting Ali Khamenei's ban on atomic weapons. Officials also threatened heavier retaliation if US-Israeli strikes resume.

top.title: Obama calls Trump probe of Rep. Ilhan Omar 'appalling'
top.description: The former president says the administration is targeting Omar for criticizing Trump, six days after federal agents searched her Washington home.

top.title: Macron vows rioters will pay after worst unrest in years
top.description: In a televised address, the French president promised "full transparency" on policing after nearly 2,400 arrests and almost 1,000 officers injured Saturday.

top.title: Carney says 4 killed, dozens hurt in fire at Canadian military base
top.description: The official toll is lower than media reports of seven dead. The RCMP is investigating Saturday's fire and explosion.

top.title: Trump's doctor never more than 3 minutes away, WSJ reports
top.description: The Journal's profile of Dr. Sean Barbabella, a Navy captain, describes a patient who doesn't always follow advice, including on daily aspirin.

top.title: Rubio urges Israel to crack down on settler violence
top.description: Rubio's comments followed video of masked settlers beating Washington Post photographer Heidi Levine during an olive harvest attack in the West Bank.

top.title: Bend shooter was former Silver Rail student, police say
top.description: Officials say the 16-year-old killed three children and a teacher in one classroom, using a shotgun his mother bought in August.

top.title: Trump endorses Netanyahu nine days before Israel election
top.description: Trump said anyone other than Bibi would be the wrong leader, warning America would otherwise have to confront Iran on its own.

top.title: FAA, controllers' union agree on 2.8% raise, badge-in rule
top.description: The raise takes effect Oct. 18, retroactive to January, and controllers must badge in and out to curb leaving shifts early.

top.title: AI-generated midterm ads hit $137 million, Wesleyan finds
top.description: Researchers flagged more than 220 AI-made ads, mostly from Republican-aligned sponsors, with spending up from about $80 million in early September.

top.title: Report details how Hegseth's execution livestream imploded
top.description: Officials told The Atlantic the plan sparked "pretty universal revulsion" before Trump scrapped it Thursday; Nidal Hasan's Dec. 3 execution stands.

top.title: Ukraine runs out of Patriot interceptors, CNN reports
top.description: A source told CNN that almost all ballistic missiles in Russia's latest strike got through because Ukraine had no interceptors left.

top.title: FEC filings show Musk's $158 million flowed to Paxton race
top.description: Each time Musk sent a September check, the Senate Leadership Fund passed the same amount to Texas PAC within a day, paying for a Texas Senate ad blitz.

top.title: Nine fired FBI staff sue Patel over Trump documents probe
top.description: The 70-page suit calls their February firings "political retribution" and asks for reinstatement, back pay and a ruling that the firings were unlawful.

top.title: US producer prices post biggest jump in over four years
top.description: Wholesale prices rose 1.3% in September, more than double forecasts, a day after hotter-than-expected CPI data raised pressure on the Fed.

top.title: FBI probes suspicious letters mailed to Congress offices
top.description: An alert to Capitol Hill staff Thursday followed white-powder mailings to election offices in Louisiana, Oklahoma and Ohio weeks before Election Day.

top.title: Zacharia ousted as press secretary after 5 days
top.description: Her exit follows a 14-minute debut briefing and admissions she never passed the bar, despite Trump calling her an attorney.

top.title: North Korea tests sub-launched strategic cruise missiles
top.description: The east coast launches, reported by KCNA on Thursday, marked Pyongyang's first underwater missile test in nearly three years, according to AP.
